# classify each 4x3-ish block by dominant hue
def cls(px):
    r,g,b=px
    if r>150 and g<90 and b<90: return 'R'   # bright red
    if r>120 and g>90 and b<90 and r>b+30: return 'o' # orange/brown/tan
    if b>r and b>g and b>90: return 'B' # blue
    if r>200 and g>200 and b>200: return '.' # white/bright
    if max(px)-min(px)<25:
        v=(r+g+b)/3
        if v<60:return '#'
        if v<110:return '+'
        if v<160:return ':'
        return '.'
    if g>r and g>b: return 'g'
    return '?'
for by in range(24):
    row=''
    for bx in range(64):
        block=a[by*6:(by+1)*6, bx*4:(bx+1)*4].reshape(-1,3).mean(0)
        row+=cls(block)
    print(f'{by*6:3d} '+row)
